signals.summary: At-home recovery build-outs — saunas, cold plunges, garage wellness hubs — as the physical expression of the recovery-over-grind mindset.
signals.why_now: Business Insider 'I Turned My Garage Into a Wellness Hub With a Sauna and Cold Plunge for $10,000' (76h), supported by a steady stream of home-sauna and recovery buyer's guides. Squarely producible as interiors and objects — exactly the category's recommended angle.

signals.summary: A real shift away from high-burn cardio toward gentle, intuitive, low-intensity movement — 'Zone 0', walking, cozy cardio and workouts that barely feel like working out.
signals.why_now: WION 'Intuitive Workouts Trend Takes Over Fitness World' (118h), ELLE 'The New Workout Trend That Makes a Case for Doing Less', WSJ 'I Tried the Workout That's All About Doing Almost Nothing' and NY Post 'Zone 0 exercise doesn't feel like exercise'. Cross-outlet and, per the category's own guidance, best served through calm environments — mats, studios, morning light — no bodies foregrounded.

signals.summary: Gentle restorative yoga — legs-up-the-wall, grounding morning flows and bedtime sequences — as a calm, sleep-adjacent movement format.
signals.why_now: A cluster of creator uploads: 'Legs Up The Wall for Better Sleep', 'Start the Day Grounded | Morning Yoga', 'Sleep Better Tonight | 10-Minute Bedtime Flow' and a 30-day flow series. Producible through mat, room and light without a recognisable face.

signals.summary: Mobility work — joint range, stretching, 'move like you're younger' routines — positioned as the longevity-minded core of a modern practice.
signals.why_now: Woman & Home 'Dr Amir Khan's 3 mobility exercises to reduce stiffness' (27h), Outside 'Want to Move Like You're Younger? Start With These 8 Mobility Moves', SELF '14 Mobility Moves Anyone Over 35 Should Add' and The Guardian 'how to start a mobility practice'. Multi-outlet; producibility is moderate since demonstrating a move implies a body.
